item.title: Chat
item.description:
Choose where to chat

You can chat with other Ubuntu users in Indonesia through the channels below. Pick whichever is most comfortable for you.

  • Telegram: Ubuntu Indonesia group | Announcement channel
  • Facebook: Ubuntu Indonesia group
  • Mailing list: id-ubuntu on Google Groups
  • Forum: forum.ubuntu-id.org

For help in English, you can also ask on Ask Ubuntu and Ubuntu Discourse.

item.title: Download Ubuntu
item.description:
Version and system requirements

Ubuntu 26.04 LTS

Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, the latest LTS(Long term support) version provides 5 years of maintenance and security updates for free. In most cases, LTS version is recommended for stable use.

See Ubuntu 26.04 LTS release notes

Ubuntu 26.10

If you want to try out latest features, Try out Ubuntu 26.10, the latest version. It provides 9 months of maintenance and security updates for free.

item.title: Group Studies/Projects
item.description:
Group Studies/Projects

We regularly hold group studies on topics about Ubuntu or related open source technologies. Costs, space, equipment, and so on needed for a study are supported by the community or sponsored separately.

Study topics are proposed by members or planned and chosen by the management team, and members are recruited through the forum or social media channels.

  • Wiki
  • GitHub Organization

Projects

We take part in open source projects on Ubuntu or related open source technologies, or develop new projects. Likewise, the resources needed to take part in or develop a project are supported by the community or sponsored separately.

item.title: Translate Ubuntu
item.description:
As an open source project, anyone can contribute to and improve the translation of the Ubuntu system UI and its bundled applications. Please join us in translating Ubuntu to make it easier for more users. Rather than translating a lot at once, it is better to translate a little accurately and consistently over time.

Take part in translating

You can take part by following the steps below.

  • Create a Launchpad account and log in
  • Find a package to translate
  • Write a translation and submit it as a suggestion
  • Ask for your suggestion to be reviewed, or wait for a review

Join the translation team

Only those who meet the requirements set out in the translation team’s rules can join the team and contribute further.
